pokedexEntries.su: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

pokedexEntries.us: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

pokedexEntries.um: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
